design.data_contamination: All historical report windows were exposed in prior research; not pristine OOS or live authorization.
design.execution: completed hourly features; exact next 5m open at T+5m; rebalance net units; charge every actual notional change; liquidate window end
design.risk: same-symbol long/short offset; absolute net exposure cap 1.0; no position-overlap exclusion
design.funding: actual timestamps/rates; mark_price if available, else settlement 5m open proxy (explicit approximation)
design.volatility_sizing: raw 1x and 20% annualized target using past 24h volatility, clipped [0.10,1.0]
design.portfolio: top 12 economic/model candidates by 2023 rank; all pairs weights .25/.5/.75; equal and training-inverse-vol mixtures; no correlation rejection
design.selection_score: min(H1,H2 return/std hourly annualized) + .25*full2023 return/MDD - 2*number of negative half-years
design.freeze: same ranking rule for all candidates; no 2024+ substitution; report five fixed finalists and controls
design.llm_rl: deferred until a viable economic teacher exists; no PPOSM action/AUC gate
